Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : The documents to be furnished by the Supplier shall be as follows:
1) Valid TIN Certificate (Up-to-date) and acknowledgement receipt
2) Valid VAT Registration Certificate
3) Valid Trade License. .
4) The Tenderer must have at least 10 years experience. (In place of existing)
5) The tenderer must have the track record of honoring a single tender of min Taka 20 Lac on electrical goods in last two (02)
years.
6) The bidder/tenderer should have the Bank solvency Certificate.
7) List of 5 organizations (Govt./ Non-Govt.) where similar projects (Electrical goods, Industrial On Line UPS, Stabilizer, Battery)
done by the company mentioning with client name, duration of project completion, total manpower involvement (enclose work
order/contract agreement)
8) Provide Minimum 1 Satisfactory Completion Certificate of Supply of Electric goods from the government/semi government
organization in last two (02) years.
9) The original money receipt/challan issued by the authority as an evidence of purchase the Tender Documents by the Tenderer.
10) The manufacturer must have ISO9001:2008.
11) In order to proof the Tenderers Financial capability necessary to perform the contract the Tenderer shall furnish the average
annual turnover (at least 45 Lac) over the last tree (03) years.
12) The minimum amount of liquid assets or working capital or credit facilities of the Tenderer shall be Tk 30 Lac.
